profiles.notes: International school-leaving routes for the selected Engineering, Science and Humanities programmes.

requirements.label: International application and supporting documents
requirements.details: Applications for 2027 undergraduate study closed 31 July 2026. The international supporting documents and English proof deadline was 30 September. The final CAIE, IB, NSSC and ZIMSEC results from the November 2026 session are due 15 January 2027.

source.title: International application and supporting documents

requirements.label: Matriculation exemption for international school results
requirements.details: For degree study, applicants using a non-South-African school-leaving credential must meet the Matriculation Board exemption requirements. Faculty-specific subjects and selection requirements also apply.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 16: Matriculation exemption for international school results

requirements.label: US Advanced Placement · matriculation exemption route
requirements.details: The South African Matriculation Board accepts an eligible US high-school graduation diploma with two College Board AP examination subjects passed at grade 3, 4 or 5 as one qualification route for exemption. This rule specifies exemption eligibility. The faculty assesses admission separately.

source.title: US Advanced Placement · matriculation exemption route

requirements.label: University English evidence where applicable
requirements.details: The general English policy lists IELTS Academic 6.5 with at least 6 each, TOEFL iBT 88 with Reading 20, Writing 19, Listening 19 and Speaking 22, PTE Academic 67 with 59 each, or a qualifying NBT Academic Literacy Test Plus report in the Upper Intermediate band. The language tests have a two-year validity period and the NBT report a three-year period. See faculty-specific conditions.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 18: University English evidence where applicable

requirements.label: Engineering and Built Environment · English and scoring
requirements.details: The faculty requires an English Language pass at the relevant school qualification level. For IGCSE English, meet the first-language condition or offer another first language. The international secondary results are assessed through subject requirements and individual review.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 37: Engineering and Built Environment · English and scoring

requirements.label: Engineering · Chemistry, Civil and Mechanical group A/AS levels
requirements.details: At A-level, meet grade B in Mathematics. Add B in A-level Chemistry with at least B in IGCSE Physics, or B in A-level Physics with at least B in IGCSE Chemistry. IGCSE English must be C or higher. The AS route lists A in Mathematics and Physics plus two B grades. The alternate combination in the table is A in Mathematics, A in either Physics or Chemistry, B in the other of Physics or Chemistry, and B in one other subject.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 38: Engineering · Chemistry, Civil and Mechanical group A/AS levels

requirements.label: Electrical, Computer and Mechatronics Engineering · A/AS levels
requirements.details: The A-level route requires B in both Mathematics and Physics, plus C in IGCSE English. The AS route requires A in Mathematics and Physics and B in two other AS subjects, plus C in IGCSE English.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 38: Electrical, Computer and Mechatronics Engineering · A/AS levels

requirements.label: Construction and Property Studies · IB subjects
requirements.details: Complete the full IB Diploma. For Mathematics and for either Physics or Chemistry, earn at least 5 at SL or 4 at HL. Mathematical Studies is excluded.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 37–38: Construction and Property Studies · IB subjects

requirements.label: Chemical, Civil and Mechanical Engineering · IB subjects
requirements.details: Complete the full IB Diploma. Each of Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry requires at least 6 at SL or 5 at HL. Mathematical Studies is excluded.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 38: Chemical, Civil and Mechanical Engineering · IB subjects

requirements.label: Engineering and Geomatics · IB Mathematics and Physics
requirements.details: Complete the full IB Diploma. Mathematics and Physics each require at least 6 at SL or 5 at HL. Mathematical Studies is excluded.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 38: Engineering and Geomatics · IB Mathematics and Physics

requirements.label: Humanities · academic English grade
requirements.details: The qualification table lists minimum English as Cambridge A-level E, AS-level D, GCSE or IGCSE C, IB HL 3 or IB SL 4. Indicative likely-offer levels are A-level D, AS-level B, GCSE or IGCSE A, IB HL 4 or IB SL 6. Matriculation exemption can impose further rules.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 58: Humanities · academic English grade

requirements.label: Humanities · Cambridge route
requirements.details: For faculty entry the prospectus calls for two A-level passes at grade C or above, with two AS-level passes potentially substituting for each A-level. For the admission-points calculation, count six relevant subjects beginning with the most senior passes and do not count any subject twice.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 57: Humanities · Cambridge route

requirements.label: Arts and Humanities · admission-points minimum
requirements.details: The faculty publishes an admission-points minimum of 32 for these programmes using its non-South-African secondary qualification assessment. This is a local admission-points calculation based on school subjects and their level.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 58: Arts and Humanities · admission-points minimum

requirements.label: Humanities · likely-offer admission points
requirements.details: The published likely-offer reference is 38 UCT admission points for these programmes. Individual assessment remains competitive.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 58: Humanities · likely-offer admission points

requirements.label: Humanities creative entry · assessed work
requirements.details: The table requires a satisfactory evaluation of a portfolio or audition as appropriate to the subject.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 58: Humanities creative entry · assessed work

profiles.notes: First-year admission with non-South-African school qualifications. See the 2027 Engineering and the Built Environment conditions.

requirements.label: Geomatics · Cambridge qualifications
requirements.details: For A-level entry, earn C or higher in Mathematics and Physics, plus IGCSE English C. The AS route requires Mathematics B, Physics C, and B in two other AS subjects. IGCSE English C also applies.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 38: Geomatics · Cambridge qualifications

profiles.notes: First-year admission with non-South-African school qualifications. See the 2027 Engineering and the Built Environment conditions.

requirements.label: Construction Studies · Cambridge qualifications
requirements.details: The A-level route requires two grades of D or higher, including Mathematics, and IGCSE Physics or Chemistry at C or higher. The AS route requires Mathematics D and three other AS-level subjects at B or higher, plus IGCSE Physics or Chemistry C.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 37: Construction Studies · Cambridge qualifications

profiles.notes: First-year admission with non-South-African school qualifications. See the 2027 Engineering and the Built Environment conditions.

requirements.label: Property Studies · Cambridge qualifications
requirements.details: The A-level route requires two results at D or higher, including Mathematics. The AS route requires Mathematics D and B in three other AS-level subjects.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 38: Property Studies · Cambridge qualifications

profiles.notes: First-year admission with non-South-African school qualifications. See the 2027 Engineering and the Built Environment conditions.

requirements.label: Architecture · portfolio and written motivation
requirements.details: Submit a written motivation and a creative portfolio. The 2027 prospectus sets 31 July 2026 as the portfolio deadline.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 5, 37: Architecture · portfolio and written motivation

requirements.label: Architecture · Cambridge qualifications
requirements.details: The A-level route requires D or better in two A-level subjects. The AS route requires C or better in four AS subjects. Both routes also require at least C in IGCSE Mathematics or Physics.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 37: Architecture · Cambridge qualifications

profiles.notes: First-year admission with non-South-African school qualifications. See the 2027 Science conditions.

requirements.label: Science · subject-based Faculty Points Score
requirements.details: The published minimum is 34 UCT Faculty Points across the best five subjects including required subjects, using the published international grade table. Limited capacity can make the competitive score higher.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 70: Science · subject-based Faculty Points Score

requirements.label: Science · Cambridge and IB prerequisite subjects
requirements.details: Cambridge applicants need IGCSE English C, A or AS Mathematics B and A or AS Physical Science, Chemistry or Physics C. The IB route requires English SL 5, Mathematics Analysis and Approaches at HL 5 or SL 6, and Physical Science or Chemistry or Physics at HL 5 or SL 6. Mathematics Applications and Interpretation and Mathematical Studies are excluded.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 70: Science · Cambridge and IB prerequisite subjects

requirements.label: Science · faculty English evidence
requirements.details: The faculty lists IELTS 7.0 overall with no element below 6.0, TOEFL iBT 88, PTE Academic 64 or NBT Academic Literacy 51% where proof is needed.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 70: Science · faculty English evidence

profiles.notes: First-year admission with non-South-African school qualifications. See the 2027 Humanities conditions.

requirements.label: PPE · mathematics requirement and likely-offer score
requirements.details: The published Mathematics minimum is A-level E, AS-level C, NSSC grade 3, IB HL 3 or IB SL 5. The UCT admission-points minimum is 32 and the likely-offer reference is 39.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 58: PPE · mathematics requirement and likely-offer score

profiles.notes: First-year admission with non-South-African school qualifications. See the 2027 Humanities conditions.

requirements.label: Music · theory test and interview
requirements.details: The Music degree also requires a satisfactory music theory test and interview.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 58: Music · theory test and interview

profiles.notes: First-year admission with non-South-African school qualifications. See the 2027 Humanities conditions.

requirements.label: Diploma school qualification and audition
requirements.details: Present a school-leaving qualification endorsed for diploma study and pass an audition. Music Performance also requires a satisfactory music theory test and interview.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 58: Diploma school qualification and audition

profiles.notes: First-year admission with non-South-African school qualifications. See the 2027 Humanities conditions.

requirements.details: Present a school-leaving qualification endorsed for diploma study and pass an audition.

source.title: UCT 2027 prospectus, printed p. 58: Diploma school qualification and audition

profiles.notes: First-year admission with non-South-African school qualifications. See the 2027 Humanities conditions.

requirements.label: Higher Certificate · eligibility routes
requirements.details: The faculty lists a National Senior Certificate, Level 4 National Certificate (Vocational), an appropriate Level 4 adult, community or early childhood education certificate, or recognition of prior learning.
